checks.name: correcting an invalid date removes the previous attempt error
unknown time removes the obsolete known-hour error
correcting a known hour removes the previous hour error
focus without editing retains the current attempt error
editing an invalid draft clears the old error and resubmission validates again
explicit resubmission uses the corrected draft and existing destination query
editing the separate reading modal preserves the birth-form error
no page errors, API requests or outbound calls

observations.scenario: known-hour failure changed to unknown time

limits: Actual built Home and native Chromium events; corrected DOM values also pass the actual CPU input parser.
Only the destination document response is replaced. No planet renderer, API write, real user DB or external AI call executes.
Hosted authentication, other browsers and physical devices are not tested.
